description: Source code implementing ASN.1 certificate parsing utilities, including functions to extract subject, SPKI, extensions, and signature algorithms from DER-encoded X.509 certificates.

methods.name: SeekToSubject
methods.description: Parses input to locate the beginning of a Certificate and prepares a parser for the Subject field.

methods.name: SeekToSPKI
methods.description: Locates the SubjectPublicKeyInfo section within a certificate.

methods.name: SeekToExtensions
methods.description: Locates the Extensions section within a certificate, if present.

methods.name: ExtractExtensionWithOID
methods.description: Extracts a specific extension from a certificate by OID.
